description: Static class histogram (jcmd GC.class_histogram). For live growth over time use heap_live_histogram_diff instead.

all.description: Include unreachable objects. Triggers full GC and may cause application pause.

pid.description: Process ID of the Java application. Get this from list_java_processes.

topN.description: Maximum number of top classes to return. Default: 20.

name: heap_histogram
